# Build Plan offer: Larkspur Ceramics

## What you get
Every purchase order is typed twice today, once into the order sheet and again into QuickBooks Online, and a product code written the wrong way ships the wrong tile. The Build Plan settles how orders should flow from email to invoice so that each one is confirmed the day it arrives, in time for your biggest customer's spring orders.

- A written Build Plan: how the work runs today, what should change, the scope, what is out of scope, acceptance checks you can run yourself, risks and what we need from you.
- A fixed quote for the build, as a separate document.
- The plan is yours to keep, whoever builds it.

## How long
2 weeks from the start date we agree.

## Fee
USD 3,000.00, payable within 14 days of the invoice.

## Credit
If you sign the build within 60 days of receiving the plan, the fee is credited against the build.

## Valid until
This offer is valid until 21 October 2026.
